scope: Independent local source and small-metadata review of the exact rendered stop body, its four-literal AST binding, and the pinned ROOT score acceptance. No stop, SSH, systemd/cgroup query, Python import, test, or score/prediction/model/data payload read was performed.

observations: The four embedded literals exactly bind the accepted invocation and complete durable ROOT acceptance; the acceptance in turn binds the result pin, exact V14 body/source review, launch acceptance/transport, status capture, and accepted export stop/manifest metadata.
The stop routine verifies the exact unit and invocation, active/exited state, strict integer 0/1/0 exit facts, and an empty campaign-slice descendant snapshot before submitting one stop request.
The bounded subprocess reader applies fixed deadlines and stdout/stderr byte caps, terminates a child it cannot finish within the deadline, and does not retry.

Cgroup traversal checks the exact campaign-slice parent, rejects symlinks, and limits directory count, per-directory entries, per-file process metadata, and aggregate process metadata. It requires empty snapshots before and after the stop.
The post-stop state requires not-found/inactive/dead, MainPID zero, and empty invocation; a nonzero stop result or populated cgroup raises an inspect-and-never-retry error.
Only the exact score-v3 unit is passed to systemctl stop. Output is a stop-status receipt and expressly makes no quality or public-transfer claim.
scope_limitations: The remote body does not re-read the score result or revalidate its payload; it relies on the pinned ROOT acceptance producer and its exact byte/SHA binding.

The unit's ControlGroup property is captured but not directly compared in _require_before; the reviewed V14 launch command and accepted LAUNCH metadata bind Slice=wnn-campaign.slice, while the stop body independently verifies and scans that exact parent slice.
